description: Permissions granted to the main window. Deliberately minimal: every entry added here is a capability the page's JavaScript can reach, and reducing what that JavaScript can do is the whole point of this application.

permissions.description: Open a link from a message in the user's browser. Scoped to http and https: without the scope this permission is 'open anything the operating system knows how to open', which includes files and executables. With it, the worst a hostile message can do is send somebody to a web page — which is what a link is.
